detail.longDescription: I am working on a Rust LKM. My kernel is Rust enabled and the Rust tool-chain is in working order. There are functions and structs from the net framework that I need to make use of in rust/bindings/bindings_generated.rs of the kernel sources on my machine. Though, if I change directory into rust/kernel and recursively grep for the function or struct, it's not in use anywhere. So my understanding is, these functions are not available in create kernel. And of course if I look in create kernel, I do not see them listed. My question is, how can I start making use of (including) these functions or struct's that appear to exist in the bindings file for my LKM?
